title: Humanize MLE Agents: Multi-Agent Session Alternation Beyond Single-Agent Limits
title_zh: Humanize MLE Agents：超越单智能体限制的多人智能体交替机制

paragraphs.en: Existing LLM-based agent approaches for long-horizon machine learning engineering (MLE) often use context engineering, implemented through custom harnesses that manage tools, skills, and accumulated experience. However, we find that as single-session execution lengthens, the agent’s reasoning intensity declines alongside slowing progress, summarized as long-horizon deceleration , and the benefits of these custom harnesses vanish as the underlying model improves, summarized as harness staleness . These findings suggest that their benefits may not persist across versions, which motivates a workflow-level approach in which agents build on one another’s work across sessions. We model these alternating agent sessions as a context-reset semi-Markov decision process ( CR-SMDP ) and establish sufficient conditions for alternation to exceed single-agent reference limits, derive an explicit experiment-budget bound, and characterize when session caps preserve this advantage. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Humanize MLE Agents ( HMA ), which alternates two agents on a shared workspace, limits each session to at most k k experiments and resets the context between sessions, without additional task-specific harness or prior knowledge supplements. Across 75 Kaggle tasks in MLE-bench, HMA reaches a state-of-the-art any-medal rate of 78.2%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 8.0 8.0 points with a quarter of its time budget. Moreover, among six configurations spanning five heterogeneous agent pairs, HMA improves any-medal rate over the constituent baselines by 6.4 6.4 points on average, demonstrating cross-pair generality. A supplementary case on kernel optimization reaches 878 cycles, within 1.6% of the community leaderboard leader, demonstrating applicability beyond MLE.
paragraphs.zh: 现有基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体方法在处理长期机器学习工程（MLE）任务时，通常采用上下文工程，通过自定义工具集来管理工具、技能和累积经验。 然而，我们发现随着单次执行时长增加，智能体的推理强度会随进展放缓而下降，这种现象可概括为“长期减速”；同时，随着基础模型性能提升，这些自定义工具集的优势也会消失，即所谓的“工具集过时”。 这些发现表明，上述方法的优势可能无法在不同版本间持续存在，因此我们提出了一种工作流层面的方法，让智能体在不同会话中相互延续彼此的工作。 我们将这些交替进行的智能体会话建模为一种上下文重置的半马尔可夫决策过程（CR-SMDP），并建立了交替执行超越单智能体参考极限的充分条件，推导出了明确的实验预算界限，并描述了在何种情况下会话限制能够保留这一优势。 基于这一分析，我们提出了“人性化MLE智能体”（HMA）：该方法在共享工作空间中交替使用两个智能体，将每轮会话限制为最多k次实验，并在会话间重置上下文，无需额外的任务专用工具集或先验知识补充。 在MLE-bench的75个Kaggle任务中，HMA实现了78.2%的最先进任意奖牌率，比最强的开源基线模型高出8.0个百分点，且仅消耗四分之一的实验时间预算。 此外，在涵盖五种异构智能体组合的六种配置中，HMA的平均任意奖牌率比其组成基线模型提升了6.4个百分点，展现了跨智能体组合的通用性。 在核优化这一补充案例中，HMA达到了878个周期，与社区排行榜第一名的差距控制在1.6%以内，证明了该方法在MLE领域之外的适用性。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agents tackle machine learning engineering (MLE) through repeated experiments: writing training code, running it, and evaluating candidate solutions ( Chan et al., 2025 ; Toledo et al., 2025 ; Karpathy, 2026 ) . For long-horizon tasks, producing a working solution is only the beginning: the agent must keep finding ways to improve it. As further gains become harder to find, the agent is expected to spend more tokens reasoning about the limitations of the current solution and deciding the next action. In our experiment across six models, however, mean output tokens per response—a proxy for reasoning intensity—decline over time as score gains diminish (Figure 2 ). We refer to this phenomenon as long-horizon deceleration and analyze its implications for prior agent design.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过反复实验来处理机器学习工程（MLE）问题：编写训练代码、运行代码并评估候选解决方案（Chan 等人，2025；Toledo 等人，2025；Karpathy，2026）。 对于长期任务而言，生成一个可行的解决方案仅仅是开始：智能体必须持续寻找改进该方案的方法。 随着进一步改进变得越来越困难，智能体预计会消耗更多标记来推理当前方案的局限性，并决定下一步行动。 然而，在我们对六个模型进行的实验中，每次响应的平均输出标记数——作为推理强度的代理指标——会随着分数提升的减少而随时间下降（图2）。 我们将这种现象称为“长期任务减速”，并分析其对以往智能体设计的影响。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches often seek to sustain improvement through context engineering, supplying Markdown instructions, skills, and accumulated knowledge to guide an agent’s next steps ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Karpathy, 2026 ; Rajasekaran et al., 2025 ) . However, guidance that helps one model need not help its successor. For example, OpenAI recommends rewriting AGENTS.md , skills, and task prompts when upgrading models ( Provencher, 2026 ) , while Anthropic advises removing instructions for checks that newer models can already perform on their own ( Anthropic, 2026c ) . As model capabilities improve, guidance that once compensated for their limitations can thus become redundant or counterproductive. We observe a related pattern in our comparison of three custom MLE harnesses—systems that manage a model’s tools, context, and execution loop ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, our comparison shows that the relative benefits of specialized harnesses diminish or reverse as the base model improves, even under longer execution budgets (Table 2 ). We refer to this decline in relative performance as harness staleness , which indicates the limitations of custom harness design.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通常试图通过上下文工程来维持改进，即向智能体提供 Markdown 指令、技能和积累的知识，以指导其后续步骤（Zhu 等人，2026；Du 等人，2026；Karpathy，2026；Rajasekaran 等人，2025）。 然而，有助于一个模型的指导并不一定有助于其后续模型。 例如，OpenAI 建议在升级模型时重写 AGENTS.md、技能和任务提示（Provencher，2026），而 Anthropic 则建议移除那些较新模型已能自行完成的检查指令（Anthropic，2026c）。 随着模型能力的提升，曾经用于弥补其局限性的指导因此可能变得多余或适得其反。 在比较三种自定义 MLE 工具包时，我们观察到了一个相关模式——这些系统负责管理模型的工具、上下文和执行循环（Zhu 等人，2026；Du 等人，2026；Zhao 等人，2026）。 尽管如此，我们的比较表明，随着基础模型的性能提升，专用工具包的相对优势会减弱甚至逆转，即便在执行预算更长的情况下也是如此（表 2）。 我们将这种相对性能的下降称为“工具包过时”，它反映了自定义工具包设计的局限性。

sents.en: We observe a related pattern in our comparison of three custom MLE harnesses—systems that manage a model’s tools, context, and execution loop ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 在比较三种自定义 MLE 工具包时，我们观察到了一个相关模式——这些系统负责管理模型的工具、上下文和执行循环（Zhu 等人，2026；Du 等人，2026；Zhao 等人，2026）。

sents.zh: 尽管如此，我们的比较表明，随着基础模型的性能提升，专用工具包的相对优势会减弱甚至逆转，即便在执行预算更长的情况下也是如此（表 2）。

sents.en: We refer to this decline in relative performance as harness staleness , which indicates the limitations of custom harness design.
sents.zh: 我们将这种相对性能的下降称为“工具包过时”，它反映了自定义工具包设计的局限性。

paragraphs.en: These limitations motivate workflow-level coordination across agent sessions , each defined as an agent’s execution from context initialization to termination. In MLE, code, trained models, and evaluated candidates persist in a shared workspace, allowing successive agents to build on prior work ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Young, 2025 ) . This persistence enables complementary roles: the agent that discovers a useful candidate need not be the one best suited to refine it, and subsequent changes can provide a new starting point when the first agent returns. We therefore ask: Can structured alternation convert complementary agent capabilities into a consistent advantage over the best single agent under a matched budget?
paragraphs.zh: 这些局限性促使我们在智能体会话之间进行工作流层面的协调，其中每次会话被定义为智能体从上下文初始化到终止的执行过程。 在 MLE 中，代码、训练好的模型和经过评估的候选方案会持续存在于共享工作区中，这使得后续的智能体能够基于先前的工作继续推进（Zhao et al., 2026；Young, 2025）。 这种持续性使得角色互补成为可能：发现有用候选方案的智能体不必是最佳优化该方案的智能体，而后续的改变可以在首个智能体返回时提供新的起点。 因此我们提出一个问题：结构化的交替执行是否能够将互补的智能体能力转化为在相同预算条件下优于单个最佳智能体的稳定优势？

paragraphs.en: To address this question, we represent alternating agent sessions as a context-reset semi-Markov decision process ( CR-SMDP ). We establish sufficient conditions and derive experiment-budget bounds under which alternation exceeds single-agent reference limits, and identify when fixed- k k interruption retains this advantage (Sections 3.1 – 3.3 ). Building on these results, we introduce Humanize MLE Agents ( HMA ), which coordinates two native agents—complete model—harness pairs using official harnesses—through a shared workspace (Figure 1 ). Each session is capped at k k experiments; after each handoff, the other agent continues with the shared work and a reset context. The workflow leaves each agent’s tools, context management, and execution loop unchanged ( Bolin, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026b ) , and provides no task-specific knowledge at initialization. Because coordination depends on completed experiments and persistent task artifacts, application to other iterative optimization tasks is a natural question. In summary, our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们将交替的智能体会话表示为一个上下文重置的半马尔可夫决策过程（CR-SMDP）。 我们建立了充分条件，并推导出了实验预算的界限：在这些条件下，交替策略会超越单智能体的参考极限；同时我们也确定了在何种情况下固定 k 次中断仍能保持这种优势（第 3.1 – 3.3 节）。 基于这些成果，我们提出了“人性化 MLE 智能体”（HMA），它通过共享工作区协调两个原生智能体——完整模型——利用官方工具包进行协作（图 1）。 每次会话最多限制为 k 次实验；每次交接后，另一个智能体会继续处理共享的工作，并使用重置后的上下文。 该工作流程保留了每个智能体的工具、上下文管理和执行循环不变（Bolin, 2026; Anthropic, 2026b），并且在初始化时不提供任何任务特定的知识。 由于协作依赖于已完成实验和持续存在的任务产物，因此将其应用于其他迭代优化任务是一个自然的问题。 总而言之，我们的贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: We identify single-agent limitations and show how HMA sustains exploration. We characterize long-horizon deceleration across six models and harness staleness across three custom MLE harnesses in Sections 2 . In contrast, from the early to the late phase of execution, HMA retains 86.4% of its mean output tokens per response, compared with 60.7% for matched single-agent baselines, indicating more persistent exploration across sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别了单智能体的局限性，并展示了 HMA 如何维持探索。 我们在第 2 节中描述了六个模型中的长期减速现象，并利用三种自定义 MLE 工具包中的过时数据。 相比之下，在执行从早期到后期的阶段中，HMA 保留了其每次响应平均输出标记的 86.4%，而匹配的单智能体基线仅为 60.7%，这表明 HMA 在不同会话中保持了更持久的探索能力。

sents.en: We identify single-agent limitations and show how HMA sustains exploration.
sents.zh: 我们识别了单智能体的局限性，并展示了 HMA 如何维持探索。

sents.en: We characterize long-horizon deceleration across six models and harness staleness across three custom MLE harnesses in Sections 2 .

sents.en: In contrast, from the early to the late phase of execution, HMA retains 86.4% of its mean output tokens per response, compared with 60.7% for matched single-agent baselines, indicating more persistent exploration across sessions.

paragraphs.en: Alternation and workflow design extend single-agent limits. Our CR-SMDP analysis establishes sufficient conditions and experiment-budget bounds for exceeding single-agent reference limits (Theorem 3.3 ), and characterizes when fixed- k k interruption preserves this advantage Theorem 3.5 ). Algorithm 1 instantiates these principles with context reset, alternating agents, and final review of candidates (Sections 3.1 – 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 交替与工作流程设计突破了单一智能体的限制。 我们的 CR-SMDP 分析确立了超越单一智能体参考极限的充分条件和实验预算界限（定理 3.3），并描述了在何种情况下固定 k 次中断能够保持这一优势（定理 3.5）。 算法 1 通过上下文重置、交替使用智能体以及对候选项的最终审查，将这些原则具体化（第 3.1 – 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: HMA achieves state-of-the-art any-medal performance with cross-pair generality. On MLE-bench, HMA achieves a state-of-the-art any-medal rate of 78.2%, exceeding the strongest published open-source workflow by 8.0 points. Across the six heterogeneous agent-pair configurations, HMA improves the any-medal rate over the constituent baselines by 6.4 points on average, with gains in every configuration (Sections 4.2 ). We also explore applicability beyond MLE-bench through a supplementary 48-hour kernel-optimization case study (Section 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: HMA 通过跨配对通用性实现了当前最先进的任意奖牌性能。 在 MLE-bench 上，HMA 实现了 78.2% 的当前最先进的任意奖牌率，比最强的已发布开源工作流高出 8.0 个百分点。 在六种异构智能体配对配置中，HMA 的任意奖牌率平均比其组成基线模型提高了 6.4 个百分点，且所有配置均有提升（第 4.2 节）。 我们还通过一项补充的 48 小时内核优化案例研究，探索了 HMA 在 MLE-bench 之外的适用性（第 4.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we investigate two limitations of single-agent MLE workflows: diminishing exploration over extended execution and limited transfer of harness improvements across model versions. These observations motivate HMA , which coordinates alternating agents from different providers to extend exploration beyond the capabilities of an individual model–harness system.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们研究了单智能体 MLE 工作流程的两个局限性：在长时间执行过程中探索能力的减弱，以及测试框架改进在不同模型版本之间的有限迁移。 这些观察结果促成了 HMA 的提出，它通过协调来自不同提供商的交替智能体，将探索范围扩展到单个模型-测试框架系统的能力之外。

paragraphs.en: We examine six single-session configurations under /goal mode. Figure 2 reports mean output tokens per response in a trailing 30-minute window, used as a proxy for the agent’s reasoning intensity. Across configurations, response length decreases by 29.8%–45.0% from hours 0–2 to hours 3–5. Together with the rapid saturation of prefix gains in Figure 3 , this reveals diminishing returns from continued single-agent exploration; detailed measurement definitions and supporting statistics are given in Appendix D.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 /goal 模式下考察了六种单次会话配置。 图 2 报告了响应中每轮输出的平均 token 数，该数据取自最后 30 分钟的时间窗口，用作衡量智能体推理强度的指标。 在所有配置中，从第 0–2 小时到第 3–5 小时，响应长度减少了 29.8%–45.0%。 结合图 3 中前缀增益的快速饱和现象，这表明持续的单智能体探索存在收益递减效应；详细的测量定义和支撑性统计数据见附录 D.1。

paragraphs.en: To counter diminishing single-agent exploration, existing harnesses introduce planning, review, and context engineering ( Young, 2025 ; Rajasekaran et al., 2025 ) . With task-specific cold-start knowledge disabled for fairness, our comparison of recent MLE harnesses ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) reveals harness staleness : their benefits relative to the official harness diminish as the backbone improves (Table 2 ). The stronger performance of the official harness is consistent with a possible benefit from model–harness alignment acquired during training. This motivates treating each agent as an integrated model–harness system and studying how agents from different providers collaborate through workflow-level coordination. We present detailed configurations and results in Appendix D.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为应对单一智能体探索能力逐渐下降的问题，现有的工具包引入了规划、审查和上下文工程（Young, 2025；Rajasekaran 等, 2025）。 出于公平性考虑，我们禁用了任务特定的冷启动知识。对近期 MLE 工具包的比较（Zhu 等, 2026；Du 等, 2026；Zhao 等, 2026）揭示了工具包的过时问题：随着基础模型性能的提升，这些工具包相较于官方工具包的优势逐渐减弱（表 2）。 官方工具包更强的性能表现与一种可能性一致，即其在训练过程中获得了模型与工具包对齐所带来的潜在优势。 这促使我们将每个智能体视为一个集成的模型–工具包系统，并研究来自不同提供商的智能体如何通过工作流层面的协调进行协作。 我们在附录 D.2 中详细展示了配置和结果。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we formulate Humanize MLE Agents ( HMA ) as a context-reset semi-MDP (Section 3.1 ), derive conditions and experiment budgets for alternation to exceed single-agent reference limits (Section 3.2 ), analyze fixed- k k interruption and empirical cap selection (Section 3.3 ), and present the complete HMA workflow (Section 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将 Humanize MLE Agents（HMA）构建为一个上下文重置的半马尔可夫决策过程（第 3.1 节），推导出交替机制超越单智能体参考极限的条件与实验预算（第 3.2 节），分析固定 k 的中断策略及经验性上限选择（第 3.3 节），并介绍完整的 HMA 工作流程（第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: We implement HMA on Humanize ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , following Algorithm 1 with GPT, Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, and Claude agents, each using their native harness and max reasoning effort. For MLE-bench, each task run uses one NVIDIA A10 GPU and a six-hour budget: agents alternate under k = 5 k=5 , reset context at each handoff, and reserve the final 15 minutes for final review. Exact model–harness mappings, hardware, baseline configurations, and framework details are given in Appendix C .

paragraphs.en: Our main evaluation uses MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , comprising 75 Kaggle competitions requiring agents to develop machine learning solutions. We report the percentage of tasks earning any medal (All) or a gold medal (Gold), supplemented by complexity-specific and leaderboard-based metrics in Table 2 . Test-set scores are unavailable to agents and used only for offline evaluation. Section 4.5 supplements this evaluation with an exploratory application to kernel optimization.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares HMA with single agents using native harnesses, evaluated in our experiments, and specialized workflows using results reported in their original papers ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Opus-first HMA achieves 78.2% overall medals, exceeding our strongest single-agent baseline at 72.4% and the highest published workflow baseline at 70.2%. HMA and our single-agent baselines share a six-hour budget, whereas the published workflows use 12–24 hours. HMA achieves these gains without task-specific knowledge bases or additional prompt engineering, while retaining the agents’ existing internal harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 比较了 HMA 与使用原生工具链的单个智能体（在我们的实验中评估），以及使用其原始论文中报告结果的专业化工作流（Zhu et al., 2026；Du et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026）。 Opus-first HMA 获得了 78.2% 的总体奖牌率，超过了我们最强的单个智能体基线模型（72.4%）以及已发表的最高工作流基线模型（70.2%）。 HMA 和我们的单个智能体基线模型共享六小时的时间预算，而已发表的工作流则使用了 12–24 小时。 HMA 在无需任务特定知识库或额外提示工程的情况下实现了这些提升，同时保留了智能体现有的内部工具链。

paragraphs.en: Across five model pairs with constituent medal rates of 54.2%–72.4%, all six HMA configurations improve overall medal rate over the stronger constituent, and Gold, Med+, and mean percentile over constituent averages. For Opus–GPT, both starting orders retain the advantage, reaching 78.2% and 73.3% medals versus the stronger constituent’s 72.4%, indicating that the observed advantage is not tied to a single favorable initial agent.
paragraphs.zh: 在五个模型对中，其组成模型的奖牌率介于 54.2%–72.4% 之间，所有六种 HMA 配置的整体奖牌率均优于更强的组成模型，且金牌数、Med+ 和平均百分位数也高于组成模型的平均值。 对于 Opus–GPT，两种初始顺序都保持了优势，分别达到了 78.2% 和 73.3% 的奖牌率，而更强的组成模型仅为 72.4%，这表明所观察到的优势并非依赖于某个单一的有利初始智能体。

sents.en: Across five model pairs with constituent medal rates of 54.2%–72.4%, all six HMA configurations improve overall medal rate over the stronger constituent, and Gold, Med+, and mean percentile over constituent averages.

sents.en: For Opus–GPT, both starting orders retain the advantage, reaching 78.2% and 73.3% medals versus the stronger constituent’s 72.4%, indicating that the observed advantage is not tied to a single favorable initial agent.
sents.zh: 对于 Opus–GPT，两种初始顺序都保持了优势，分别达到了 78.2% 和 73.3% 的奖牌率，而更强的组成模型仅为 72.4%，这表明所观察到的优势并非依赖于某个单一的有利初始智能体。

paragraphs.en: Holding exploration fixed, final review changes 8.9% of selections and increases any-medal outcomes from 311 to 319, with no losses relative to the pre-review candidate. Among the 450 task runs, 330 produce at least one medal-winning exploration candidate; final selection retains a medal in 319 of these runs (96.7%), compared with 311 (94.2%) before final review. These results quantify how terminal review supports the best-result retention objective in Assumption 3.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 在保持探索不变的情况下，最终审查改变了 8.9% 的选择，并将任何奖牌的结果从 311 增加到 319，与审查前的候选者相比没有损失。 在 450 次任务运行中，有 330 次产生了至少一个赢得奖牌的探索候选者；最终选择在这些运行中有 319 次保留了奖牌（96.7%），而最终审查前为 311 次（94.2%）。 这些结果量化了终端审查如何支持假设 3.1 中的最佳结果保留目标。

paragraphs.en: On INGV Volcanic Eruption Prediction, GPT and Opus improve the historical best MAE in five of six post-handoff options (Figure 5 ). Their final MAE of 34,234 is 46.5% below the best of six constituent goal runs. Mean response length also increases on four of five returns to a previously used model, illustrating continued refinement of shared task state alongside renewed output. Appendix G provides detailed measurements and additional cross-model cases.
paragraphs.zh: 在 INGV 火山喷发预测任务中，GPT 和 Opus 在六个移交后选项中的五个上改进了历史最佳 MAE（图 5）。 它们最终的 MAE 为 34,234，比六个组成目标运行中的最佳值低 46.5%。 在五次返回先前使用的模型中，有四次平均响应长度也增加了，这表明共享任务状态在输出更新的同时持续得到了优化。 附录 G 提供了详细的测量数据和额外的跨模型案例。

paragraphs.en: The preceding case illustrates continued refinement within MLE. We next explore the workflow on Anthropic’s Original Performance Take-Home (AOPT) ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , a kernel-optimization task measured in simulated execution cycles. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6-astra alternate with a cap of three accepted submissions per session (cap 3). The selected 48-hour run reaches 878 cycles at 34 hours 33 minutes and retains this score in its final candidate. Figure 6 pairs the performance trajectory with response-length traces, following the presentation in Figure 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 前面的案例说明了 MLE 中的持续优化。 接下来，我们将探讨 Anthropic 的原始性能带回家（AOPT）（Anthropic, 2026a）的工作流程，这是一项以模拟执行周期为衡量标准的内核优化任务。 Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6-astra 交替使用，每轮最多允许提交三次（上限为 3）。 选定的 48 小时运行在 34 小时 33 分钟时达到 878 个周期，并在最终候选结果中保持这一分数。 图 6 将性能轨迹与响应长度轨迹进行了对照，遵循了图 5 的呈现方式。

paragraphs.en: For context, 878 cycles matches the 10th-ranked score on the Paradigm community leaderboard as of October 8, 2026 ( Paradigm, 2026 ) , just 14 cycles (1.62%) above the leading score of 864 cycles. The leaderboard uses a separate nine-seed judge, so this is a comparison of reported scores rather than a verified leaderboard placement. This single-run case provides preliminary evidence of the workflow’s applicability to kernel optimization beyond MLE-bench over a longer horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 作为背景信息，截至2026年10月8日，878个周期在Paradigm社区排行榜上对应第10名的得分（Paradigm, 2026），仅比领先的864个周期的得分高出14个周期（1.62%）。 该排行榜使用了一个独立的九种子评判器，因此这属于已报告得分之间的比较，而非经过验证的排行榜排名。 这一单次运行案例初步证明了该工作流程在更长时间范围内，不仅适用于MLE-bench，也适用于内核优化。

paragraphs.en: MLE-bench evaluates autonomous agents on Kaggle competitions ( Chan et al., 2025 ) . Recent MLE systems improve individual agents through search, reflection, memory, branch reuse, recoverable workspaces, or task-conditioned interfaces ( Toledo et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Du et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . These methods modify how one model acts within its harness. HMA instead leaves each native model–harness pair unchanged and coordinates complete agents at the workflow level.
paragraphs.zh: MLE-bench 在 Kaggle 竞赛中评估自主智能体（Chan 等人，2025）。 近期的 MLE 系统通过搜索、反思、记忆、分支复用、可恢复工作区或任务相关接口来改进单个智能体（Toledo 等人，2025；Chen 等人，2026；Du 等人，2026；Zhu 等人，2026；Zhao 等人，2026；Yu 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026；Ye 等人，2026）。 这些方法改变了单个模型在其运行环境中的行为方式。 而 HMA 则保持每个原生模型与运行环境的组合不变，并在工作流程层面协调完整的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Prior workflows sustain long-horizon execution through reusable experience, reflection, tree search, workflow search, communication, role assignment, checkpointing, or independent review ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Recent handoff studies examine candidate transfer, learned control exchange, and the quality cost of continuing another model’s trajectory ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Ganz et al., 2026 ) . HMA studies fixed-cap alternation of complete native agents on one shared workspace, with a context reset at every handoff.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作流程通过可重用的经验、反思、树搜索、工作流搜索、通信、角色分配、检查点或独立审查来维持长期执行（Shinn 等，2023；Zhao 等，2024；Zhou 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025；Wu 等，2024；Qian 等，2024；Li 等，2025）。 近期的交接研究探讨了候选模型转移、学习到的控制交换，以及延续另一模型轨迹所带来的质量成本（Luo 等，2026；Li 等，2026；Ganz 等，2026）。 HMA 研究在单一共享工作空间上固定地交替使用完整的原生智能体，并在每次交接时重置上下文。

paragraphs.en: Semi-Markov decision processes model actions with variable duration, while options represent such actions through an internal policy and termination rule ( Bradtke and Duff, 1994 ; Dietterich, 2000 ) . The interruption theorem characterizes when terminating an option early preserves or improves continuation value ( Sutton et al., 1999 ) ; subsequent work studies learned and off-policy termination ( Bacon et al., 2017 ; Harutyunyan et al., 2018 ) . HMA models each agent session as an option and applies this framework to fixed-cap alternation with context reset.
paragraphs.zh: 半马尔可夫决策过程将动作建模为具有可变持续时间的行为，而选项则通过内部策略和终止规则来表示此类动作（Bradtke 和 Duff，1994；Dietterich，2000）。 中断定理描述了在何种情况下提前终止一个选项能够保持或提升其延续价值（Sutton 等，1999）；后续研究则探讨了学习型和非策略型的终止方法（Bacon 等，2017；Harutyunyan 等，2018）。 HMA 将每个智能体会话建模为一个选项，并将该框架应用于具有上下文重置的固定容量交替。

paragraphs.en: HMA alternates native agents, resetting context while preserving shared task state. Our CR-SMDP analysis gives sufficient conditions and budget bounds for exceeding single-agent reference limits and conditions for preserving this advantage under fixed-cap interruption. Across six MLE-bench configurations, HMA outperforms the stronger constituent in medal rate under equal six-hour budgets, reaching 78.2% at best. A supplementary AOPT case illustrates application to kernel optimization over 48 hours; establishing comparative gains beyond MLE-bench remains future work. Together, these results motivate further study of workflow-level coordination for sustained exploration across iterative optimization tasks.
paragraphs.zh: HMA 交替使用原生智能体，在重置上下文的同时保留共享任务状态。 我们的 CR-SMDP 分析为超越单智能体参考限制提供了充分条件和预算界限，并明确了在固定容量中断下保持这一优势的条件。 在六个 MLE-bench 配置中，HMA 在相同六小时预算下的奖牌率优于其更强的组成智能体，最佳表现达到 78.2%。 一个补充的 AOPT 案例展示了其在 48 小时内内核优化中的应用；确立超越 MLE-bench 的比较性增益仍是未来的工作。 综合来看，这些结果推动了进一步研究工作流程层面的协调机制，以实现迭代优化任务中的持续探索。

The research ideas, methodology, experimental design, and interpretation of results were developed by the authors. We reviewed all AI-assisted text to ensure that it accurately conveyed our intended meaning. LLM-generated code was verified and tested for correctness by two authors. We take full responsibility for the final content of this work, including all text, claims, and artifacts produced with the assistance of generative AI.

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 reports mean output tokens per recorded model response. At one-minute active-runtime checkpoints, we divide the sum of provider-reported output tokens by the number of responses in the preceding 30 minutes, pooling the 75 tasks and repeats within each configuration. paragraphs.en: At each active-runtime checkpoint, we aggregate the medal status of the latest accepted candidate on each task, assigning zero before a valid submission. Final points use the returned candidate under the recorded selection rule. Scores use the corrected answer keys. Receipt processing at the nominal deadline is included in the final point. Token counts measure output volume across different tokenizers, not a common monetary or computational cost. Neither panel extrapolates trajectories or uses best-so-far score selection.

paragraphs.en: We compare GPT-first and Kimi-first alternation under NTA and HMA with k = 5 k=5 , then relate the endpoint differences to model-session time and partner participation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 NTA 和 HMA（k = 5 k=5）条件下比较了 GPT-first 与 Kimi-first 的交替策略，然后将终点的差异与模型会话时间和参与方关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Each configuration covers the same 75 tasks with a six-hour budget and max reasoning effort. The additional Kimi-first HMA run records 283 exploration options: among the 75 initial options, 52 reach the cap, 22 end naturally, and one reaches the deadline. The GPT-first k = 5 k=5 run records 277 exploration options, with 66 initial cap closures and nine natural exits. Corrected answer keys give 42/75 medals for Kimi-first NTA , including three corrected outcomes. For the Kimi-first HMA archive, the terminal window is 21,700 seconds; all accepted candidates arrive within 21,600 seconds and its six-hour medal count matches the returned result.

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 (a) compares both GPT–Kimi starting orders under the six-hour budget. NTA reaches 77.3% and 56.0% medals with GPT and Kimi first, respectively; HMA with k = 5 k=5 reaches 70.7% and 66.7%, narrowing the observed gap from 21.3 to 4.0 percentage points. The six-hour horizon limits sustained participation by both agents under NTA : by 5.75 hours, the second agent has produced a recorded response on only 19/75 GPT-first tasks and 47/75 Kimi-first tasks. Under NTA , the nominal first model occupies about 81–83% of the budget. Because the GPT goal baseline is stronger than the Kimi baseline (68.0% versus 54.2%), the longer uninterrupted GPT exposure in the GPT-first archive is associated with the higher NTA result. GPT-first HMA instead allocates 51.1% to GPT and 46.3% to Kimi, whereas Kimi-first HMA still allocates 81.3% to Kimi and only 16.2% to GPT. These finite-budget differences accord with the startup effects in Appendix A.2 ; improvement from interruption remains conditional on continuation advantage (Theorem 3.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 7(a) 比较了两种 GPT–Kimi 初始顺序在六小时预算下的表现。 当优先使用 GPT 和 Kimi 时，NTA 分别达到 77.3% 和 56.0% 的奖牌率；而当 k = 5 时，HMA 的奖牌率分别为 70.7% 和 66.7%，从而将观察到的差距从 21.3 个百分点缩小至 4.0 个百分点。 在六小时的时间范围内，NTA 限制了两种智能体的持续参与：到第 5.75 小时时，第二个智能体仅在 GPT 优先的 75 个任务中完成了 19 个，在 Kimi 优先的 75 个任务中完成了 47 个。 在 NTA 条件下，名义上的首选模型占据了约 81–83% 的预算。 由于 GPT 目标基线比 Kimi 基线更强（68.0% 对比 54.2%），因此 GPT 优先存档中更长时间、不间断的 GPT 使用与更高的 NTA 结果相关。 相比之下，GPT 优先的 HMA 将 51.1% 的预算分配给 GPT，46.3% 分配给 Kimi；而 Kimi 优先的 HMA 仍分配 81.3% 给 Kimi，仅分配 16.2% 给 GPT。 这些有限预算下的差异与附录 A.2 中提到的启动效应一致；由中断带来的改进仍然取决于持续优势（定理 3.5）。

paragraphs.en: A larger cap permits longer uninterrupted experiment blocks before handoff, while the six-hour deadline limits the partner’s subsequent search. Given GPT’s stronger standalone performance, the GPT-first cap trend and higher GPT-first NTA result are consistent with a benefit from preserving more continuous GPT search. Conversely, k = 5 k=5 improves the Kimi-first result and reduces sensitivity to the initial agent. The limited horizon can therefore leave the pair’s complementary capabilities incompletely exploited, making cap size and initial-agent choice jointly relevant. The recorded starting-order exceptions in Appendix F.1 delimit this interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 更大的上限允许在交接前进行更长的不间断实验阶段，而六小时的时限则限制了合作伙伴随后的搜索。 鉴于 GPT 更强的独立性能，优先使用 GPT 的上限趋势以及更高的优先使用 GPT 的 NTA 结果，与保留更多连续 GPT 搜索所带来的优势一致。 相反，k = 5 能改善优先使用 Kimi 的结果，并降低对初始智能体的敏感度。 因此，有限的实验周期可能导致这对智能体的互补能力未能被充分利用，使得上限大小和初始智能体的选择共同产生影响。 附录 F.1 中记录的起始顺序例外情况为这一解释划定了界限。

sents.en: The recorded starting-order exceptions in Appendix F.1 delimit this interpretation.
sents.zh: 附录 F.1 中记录的起始顺序例外情况为这一解释划定了界限。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate retention of historically attained any-medal outcomes on the same 450 task runs as Appendix F.3 , supplementing the mechanism in Section 3.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在附录 F.3 使用的相同 450 次任务运行中，评估历史上获得的任意奖牌结果的保留情况，并对第 3.4 节中的机制进行了补充。

paragraphs.en: We hold each recorded exploration trajectory fixed and compare the returned candidate with the candidate standing immediately before final review. The reserved final review time is not reallocated to search, so this measures the effect of final selection rather than a rerun with a longer exploration budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每条已记录的探索轨迹固定不变，并将返回的候选方案与最终评审前紧邻的候选方案进行比较。 预留的最终评审时间不会重新分配给搜索过程，因此这一指标衡量的是最终选择的效果，而非在更长的探索预算下重新运行所带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: For each task run, historical any-medal status is one if any accepted exploration candidate earns bronze or better, and zero otherwise. We compute this status from offline evaluator records before final review; repeated receipts for a reviewed candidate add no new historical outcome. Historical any-medal retention is the fraction of historically medal-positive task runs whose selected candidate earns a medal. Table 13 compares this fraction before and after final review. Of 450 task runs, 330 produce a medal-winning candidate; final review raises retained medals from 311/330 (94.2%) to 319/330 (96.7%), recovering eight medals without losing any held immediately before final review.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次任务运行中，历史“任意奖牌”状态为 1（若任何被接受的探索候选者获得铜牌或更高成绩），否则为 0。 我们在最终评审前根据离线评估器记录计算此状态；对于已评审的候选者，重复获得的记录不会增加新的历史结果。 历史“任意奖牌”保留率是指历史上获得奖牌的任务运行中，所选候选者实际赢得奖牌的比例。 表 13 比较了最终评审前后这一比例的变化。 在 450 次任务运行中，有 330 次产生了赢得奖牌的候选者；最终评审使保留的奖牌数从 311/330（94.2%）提升至 319/330（96.7%），即在未损失任何最终评审前已保留奖牌的情况下，额外恢复了八枚奖牌。

Thirty-five GLM-pair final reviews are silent and one DeepSeek-pair final review fails; their recorded fallback candidates remain included. This audit measures historical any-medal retention at final selection.

paragraphs.en: On MBM-01 with GPT–DeepSeek-V4.1, the first GPT option reaches 0.84671 without a medal, and DeepSeek reaches bronze at 0.85445. The returning GPT replaces the standing result with 0.75795; final review restores the archived DeepSeek candidate and recovers the medal. On MBM-20 with GPT–GLM, GPT produces a gold-medal candidate at 0.84835, but the final GLM candidate scores 0.25403; final review restores 0.84835. In aggregate, final review reduces missed historical medals from 19 to 11, supporting its role in retaining search outcomes at final selection.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MBM-01 上，使用 GPT–DeepSeek-V4.1 时，第一个 GPT 选项在没有获得奖牌的情况下达到了 0.84671，而 DeepSeek 则以 0.85445 获得了铜牌。 回归的 GPT 将现有结果替换为 0.75795；最终评审恢复了存档的 DeepSeek 候选方案，并重新获得了奖牌。 在 MBM-20 上，使用 GPT–GLM 时，GPT 生成了一个获得金牌的候选方案，得分为 0.84835，但最终 GLM 候选方案的得分为 0.25403；最终评审恢复了 0.84835 这一分数。 总体而言，最终评审将错过的历史奖牌数从 19 个减少到了 11 个，这支持了它在最终选择中保留搜索结果的作用。

paragraphs.en: We examine four model pairs across five model families: GPT–Opus, GPT–DeepSeek, GLM–Kimi, and DeepSeek–Kimi. The INGV case in Section 4.4 is followed by examples from text prediction, image regression, and satellite positioning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了五个模型系列中的四对模型：GPT–Opus、GPT–DeepSeek、GLM–Kimi 和 DeepSeek–Kimi。 在第 4.4 节中介绍的 INGV 案例之后，我们提供了文本预测、图像回归和卫星定位的示例。

sents.en: We examine four model pairs across five model families: GPT–Opus, GPT–DeepSeek, GLM–Kimi, and DeepSeek–Kimi.
sents.zh: 我们研究了五个模型系列中的四对模型：GPT–Opus、GPT–DeepSeek、GLM–Kimi 和 DeepSeek–Kimi。

sents.en: The INGV case in Section 4.4 is followed by examples from text prediction, image regression, and satellite positioning.
sents.zh: 在第 4.4 节中介绍的 INGV 案例之后，我们提供了文本预测、图像回归和卫星定位的示例。

paragraphs.en: We selected task runs with inspectable artifacts, controller logs, evaluator receipts, and native response records. GPT–Opus, GPT–DeepSeek, and DeepSeek–Kimi occur in the main comparison; GLM–Kimi is an additional combination using the same k = 5 k=5 workflow. Following the trajectory analysis of Zhao et al. (2026) , we align each accepted candidate with its producing option using controller counts and receipt times. Test scores are evaluated offline and were hidden from the agents; all accepted scores, including regressions, are plotted. Goal references use three runs per constituent. The appendix figures compare disjoint first- and last-20-response windows; options with fewer than 40 responses show their counts instead. Final review is excluded from token statistics and preserves the standing candidate in all four cases. Response renewal is compared within the same model, since tokenizers and policies differ. These cases illustrate observed mechanisms rather than estimating their average causal effect.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了具有可检查产物、控制器日志、评估器收据和本土响应记录的任务运行。GPT–Opus、GPT–DeepSeek 和 DeepSeek–Kimi 出现在主要对比中；GLM–Kimi 是使用相同 k = 5 k=5 工作流的一个额外组合。遵循 Zhao 等人（2026）的轨迹分析方法，我们利用控制器计数和收据时间将每个被接受的候选项与其生成选项进行匹配。测试分数是在线下评估的，并且未向智能体展示；所有被接受的分数（包括回归值）均已绘制在图中。目标引用对每个组成要素使用三次运行。附录中的图表比较了互不重叠的首 20 个响应和末 20 个响应的窗口；响应次数少于 40 次的选项则显示其计数。最终审查未包含在令牌统计中，并且在所有四种情况下都保留了当前的候选项。由于分词器和策略存在差异，因此响应更新仅在相同模型内部进行比较。这些案例旨在展示观察到的机制，而非估算其平均因果效应。

paragraphs.en: On INGV (MBH-07), GPT and Opus complete seven exploration options with 5, 5, 5, 2, 5, 1, and 4 accepted experiments and 77, 263, 251, 59, 110, 49, and 48 responses, respectively. Options 1, 2, 3, and 5 reach the cap; options 4 and 6 end naturally, and option 7 reaches the deadline. Their best MAEs are 1,123,915, 41,214, 39,061, 39,878, 37,422, 36,934, and 34,234: five of the six post-handoff options improve the historical best, while the fourth option regresses. Shared features and cached predictions support successive refinements. The trace records GPT reusing and pruning Opus’s retrieval features, Opus adding consistency constraints for paired windows, GPT introducing an uncertainty-based residual gate, Opus refining its calibration, and GPT enforcing joint temporal feasibility.
paragraphs.zh: 在 INGV (MBH-07) 上，GPT 和 Opus 完成了七个探索选项，分别接受了 5、5、5、2、5、1 和 4 次实验，并获得了 77、263、251、59、110、49 和 48 个响应。 选项 1、2、3 和 5 达到了上限；选项 4 和 6 自然结束，而选项 7 则达到了截止日期。 它们的最佳 MAE 分别为 1,123,915、41,214、39,061、39,878、37,422、36,934 和 34,234：六个移交后选项中有五个优于历史最佳值，而第四个选项则出现倒退。 共享特征和缓存预测支持了连续的精炼过程。 追踪记录显示，GPT 重用了 Opus 的检索特征并进行了剪枝；Opus 为成对窗口添加了一致性约束；GPT 引入了一种基于不确定性的残差门控机制；Opus 对其校准进行了优化；GPT 则强制执行了联合时间可行性。

paragraphs.en: After the first Opus session reaches 41,214 MAE, subsequent alternation lowers it to 34,234, a further 16.9% improvement and 46.5% below the best of six constituent goal runs (63,991). Native MAE resolves progress beyond the already-gold goal results. Figure 5 (a) retains all 27 accepted scores, including regressions, without smoothing; it uses a logarithmic axis with a linear inset for late options. Horizontal lines mark the gold threshold (3,971,366), the minimum MAE in MLE-bench’s 621-entry reference leaderboard (3,438,191), and the best constituent goal endpoint. Blue and purple regions identify GPT and Opus, and dotted vertical lines mark handoffs.
paragraphs.zh: 在首个 Opus 会话的 MAE 达到 41,214 后，后续的交替操作将其降至 34,234，进一步提升了 16.9%，且比六个组成目标运行中的最佳结果（63,991）低 46.5%。 原生 MAE 解决了在已有黄金级目标结果之外的进展问题。 图 5(a) 保留了所有 27 个被接受的分数，包括回归值，且未进行平滑处理；该图使用对数坐标轴，并在晚期选项处加入了线性插图。 水平线分别标记了黄金阈值（3,971,366）、MLE-bench 参考排行榜中 621 个条目中的最低 MAE（3,438,191），以及最佳组成目标终点。 蓝色和紫色区域分别表示 GPT 和 Opus，虚线垂直线则标记了交接点。

sents.en: After the first Opus session reaches 41,214 MAE, subsequent alternation lowers it to 34,234, a further 16.9% improvement and 46.5% below the best of six constituent goal runs (63,991).
sents.zh: 在首个 Opus 会话的 MAE 达到 41,214 后，后续的交替操作将其降至 34,234，进一步提升了 16.9%，且比六个组成目标运行中的最佳结果（63,991）低 46.5%。

sents.en: Native MAE resolves progress beyond the already-gold goal results.
sents.zh: 原生 MAE 解决了在已有黄金级目标结果之外的进展问题。

sents.en: Figure 5 (a) retains all 27 accepted scores, including regressions, without smoothing; it uses a logarithmic axis with a linear inset for late options.

sents.en: Horizontal lines mark the gold threshold (3,971,366), the minimum MAE in MLE-bench’s 621-entry reference leaderboard (3,438,191), and the best constituent goal endpoint.

paragraphs.en: In Figure 5 (b), each point averages output tokens per response from the preceding accepted submission or option start to the current acceptance. The 27 intervals contain 826 responses, excluding 31 trailing responses; final review is excluded. Comparing the first experiment after each return with the same model’s preceding last experiment, mean response length increases on four of five returns by a factor of 1.6–3.6; the final Opus return has a ratio of 0.94.

paragraphs.en: On Google QUEST Q&A Labeling (MBM-10), GPT-5.6-sol and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash complete seven options, five of which produce 23 accepted candidates. GPT initializes sparse-text and encoder models; DeepSeek completes additional DeBERTa fits and combines their saved predictions. Subsequent sessions reuse these artifacts for target-specific blending, calibration, and larger-encoder refinement. The first five options achieve best Spearman correlations of 0.45664, 0.47124, 0.48741, 0.50381, and 0.50760. The returned candidate scores 0.50747, versus 0.47252 for the best of six constituent goal runs (Figure 8 ). At the first returns, GPT’s mean response length rises from 168.9 to 529.1 tokens and DeepSeek’s from 647.2 to 1060.9; GPT’s next return instead falls from 616.7 to 339.2. The final two options produce no accepted experiment, so neither response renewal nor useful progress occurs at every handoff.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Google QUEST Q&A 标注任务（MBM-10）中，GPT-5.6-sol 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 完成了七个选项，其中五个选项生成了 23 个被接受的候选结果。 GPT 初始化了稀疏文本模型和编码器模型；DeepSeek 完成了额外的 DeBERTa 适配，并结合了它们保存的预测结果。 后续会话会复用这些成果，用于针对特定目标的融合、校准以及更大编码器的优化。 前五个选项实现了最佳的斯皮尔曼相关系数，分别为 0.45664、0.47124、0.48741、0.50381 和 0.50760。 返回的候选结果得分为 0.50747，而六个子目标运行中的最佳结果得分为 0.47252（图 8）。 在首次返回时，GPT 的平均响应长度从 168.9 个词元增至 529.1 个词元，DeepSeek 则从 647.2 个词元增至 1060.9 个词元；而 GPT 的第二次返回长度反而从 616.7 个词元降至 339.2 个词元。 最后两个选项未产生任何被接受的实验结果，因此在每次交接时，既没有发生响应更新，也没有取得有效进展。

paragraphs.en: On PetFinder Pawpularity (MBM-27), GLM-5.3 builds CLIP and DINOv2 feature caches, regressors, and calibrated predictions before Kimi K3 takes over at 2.40 hours. Kimi reuses the out-of-fold predictions in a constrained stack and adds concatenated-feature ridge and MLP members, improving the best test RMSE from 16.87437 to 16.78333. Returning GLM explores further combinations and reaches 16.77953; the returned candidate scores 16.85639 and earns gold (Figure 9 ). Neither constituent earns a medal in its three goal runs. The three productive options contain 5, 5, and 3 experiments; the final Kimi option adds none. GLM’s returning first 20 responses average 724.5 tokens, compared with 503.8 in its preceding option’s last 20. The final score regression remains visible: artifact reuse improves the search trajectory without ensuring that the returned candidate is its best.
paragraphs.zh: 在 PetFinder Pawpularity (MBM-27) 上，GLM-5.3 先构建 CLIP 和 DINOv2 特征缓存、回归模型以及校准后的预测结果，之后 Kimi K3 在 2.40 小时处接管。 Kimi 在受约束的堆叠模型中复用了折叠外预测结果，并添加了拼接特征的岭回归和 MLP 成员，将最佳测试 RMSE 从 16.87437 提升至 16.78333。 返回 GLM 进一步探索了组合方案，达到了 16.77953；而返回的候选模型得分为 16.85639，并获得了金牌（图 9）。 这两个组成部分在其三次目标运行中均未获得奖牌。 三种有效方案分别包含 5、5 和 3 次实验；最终的 Kimi 方案未增加任何实验。 GLM 返回的前 20 个响应平均为 724.5 个词元，而此前方案的最后 20 个响应平均为 503.8 个词元。 最终得分的回归趋势依然明显：复用人工制品改善了搜索轨迹，但并未保证返回的候选模型就是最佳模型。

paragraphs.en: On the Google Smartphone Decimeter Challenge 2022 (MBH-12), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash builds a GNSS fusion pipeline with Doppler constraints and robust optimization, reaching 4.33091 mean haversine error. Kimi K3 improves it to 4.28914, but DeepSeek’s next option leaves a worse candidate at 5.35529. Returning at 5.08 hours, Kimi retains the shared solver, checks the mean-error objective, and replaces straight-line extrapolation through an end-of-log outage with a direction-matched route from public training trajectories. Its accepted candidate reaches 2.77310 and earns bronze, a 42.1% reduction from the best of six constituent goal endpoints (4.78536), none of which earns a medal (Figure 10 ). Kimi’s first 20 returning responses average 847.9 tokens, below the preceding Kimi option’s last-20 mean of 1010.0. This late quality gain therefore does not require a response-length rebound.
paragraphs.zh: 在 2022 年谷歌智能手机分米挑战（MBH-12）中，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 构建了一个包含多普勒约束和鲁棒优化的 GNSS 融合流程，实现了 4.33091 的平均哈弗辛误差。 Kimi K3 将其改进至 4.28914，但 DeepSeek 的下一个方案却留下了一个更差的候选结果（5.35529）。 在返回时耗时 5.08 小时，Kimi 保留了共享求解器，检查了平均误差目标函数，并用一条与方向匹配的路线（来自公开训练轨迹）替代了通过对数记录末端中断进行的直线外推。 其被接受的候选结果达到了 2.77310 并获得了铜牌，比六个组成目标终点中的最佳值（4.78536）降低了 42.1%，而这些终点中没有一个能获得奖牌（图 10）。 Kimi 首次返回的 20 个响应平均为 847.9 个词元，低于此前 Kimi 方案最后 20 个响应的平均值 1010.0。 因此，这种后期的质量提升并不需要响应长度的反弹。
